data.name: Island Airfields
data.author: dioramawork
data.description:
Experimental v44 release candidate. Planes and helicopters can land on your captured islands, use hangars for repair, refuelling and rearming, and take off again on a new order.
Ground taxiing is unfinished: aircraft are repositioned between the runway or pad and the hangar. Fixed-wing aircraft and flight assistance are enabled in the candidate settings.
Requires the matching CC2X extender and plugin from the release ZIP (dinput8.dll and cc2x_island_airfields.dll in the game folder). Without them only map markers and ordinary waypoints are available.
Windows game version 1.5.18. Single player; multiplayer not release-tested. No VR or dedicated server support.
